title: Installation Price Book: Replacement System Installations Package Prices by Capacity
content:
# Installation Price Book — Replacement System Installations

Each Replacement System Installations package is priced by the nominal capacity of the system contracted. The package price for a capacity is a single figure per package; six capacities are listed for every package.

## Package price schedule (USD)

| Package | 2.0 tons | 2.5 tons | 3.0 tons | 3.5 tons | 4.0 tons | 5.0 tons |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | $8495.00 | $8895.00 | $9295.00 | $9795.00 | $10295.00 | $11195.00 |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | $9695.00 | $10195.00 | $10695.00 | $11295.00 | $11895.00 | $12895.00 |
| Harbison Performance Series System | $11495.00 | $12095.00 | $12695.00 | $13395.00 | $14095.00 | $15295.00 |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | $13295.00 | $13995.00 | $14695.00 | $15495.00 | $16295.00 | $17695.00 |
| Harbison Signature Series System | $15195.00 | $15995.00 | $16795.00 | $17695.00 | $18595.00 | $20195.00 |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | $18495.00 | $19395.00 | $20295.00 | $21395.00 | $22495.00 | $24295.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- A row is a package; a column is the capacity in tons. The figure where they meet is the package price for that capacity.
- The capacities in the columns are the only capacities listed for any package.
- Figures are whole package prices in US dollars; they are not monthly or per-ton amounts.

## Illustrations (hypothetical selections)

- A hypothetical 3.5-ton Harbison Performance Series System reads $13395.00 from the schedule.
- A hypothetical 2.0-ton Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System reads $18495.00.
- Between two neighbouring capacities of one package the schedule steps up: for the Harbison Essential Series System, 4.0 tons reads $10295.00 and 5.0 tons reads $11195.00.
